description: This file defines the EcsCredentialProvider class, which is responsible for fetching container credentials from ECS (Elastic Container Service) environment variables and metadata endpoints. It includes logic for constructing requests, handling retries, and processing the credentials response.

classes.name: EcsCredentialProvider
classes.description: Provides AWS ECS container credentials by querying environment variables and container metadata endpoints, supporting retries and token handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with optional configuration options such as timeout, retries, and custom HTTP client.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Loads container credentials asynchronously, returning a promise that resolves with the credentials or throws an exception.

methods.name: getAttempts
methods.description: Returns the number of credential retrieval attempts made.

methods.name: getEcsAuthToken
methods.description: Retrieves the authorization token from environment variables or from a specified file.

methods.name: getHeadersForAuthToken
methods.description: Creates headers required for the credential request, particularly including the authorization token.

methods.name: setHeaderForAuthToken
methods.description: Deprecated method for setting authorization headers.

methods.name: getEcsUri
methods.description: Constructs and returns the URI used to request container credentials from environment variables or instance metadata endpoints.

methods.name: decodeResult
methods.description: Parses and validates the JSON response containing credentials.

methods.name: isCompatibleUri
methods.description: Checks if a given URI is compatible with expected ECS metadata URI patterns.
